study: Retrospective leave-study-out prediction of aquatic biomass slopes
status: Exploratory held-out-by-fitting reanalysis; all source data have previously been inspected
resource: Reported biomass; object cost proportional to body mass in each source study's units
coordinate: Reported body mass; slopes invariant to constant changes of mass units

excluded_studies.StudyID_07: Known invalid upper size bounds; no correction inferred from slopes

primary_errors: Directly reported finite positive SlopeSE only
sensitivity_errors: Direct SE preferred; otherwise ordered confidence-bound width divided by 3.92 under an unverified 95%-Gaussian assumption
training_weights: Equal total weight per study, then equal weight per row within study
location_estimator: Weighted mean; the held-out study is excluded from every fitted quantity
shared_spread_estimator: max(0, weighted centered slope variance minus weighted squared standard error)
primary_score: Mean held-out log predictive density per study, aggregated with equal study weights
point_sensitivity: All eligible slopes, comparing -1 against the training median of study medians by held-study mean absolute error
inference: Descriptive overlapping-fold transport scores; no independent-fold p-value or population equivalence verdict
randomness: Deterministic selection, fitting, and scoring; no random seed
